# Orion

> Orion turns business logic into live APIs without building a microservice for
> each one. Logic is declared as JSON workflows and exposed through channels
> (REST/Kafka service endpoints) via a REST admin API, with rate limiting,
> circuit breakers, caching, validation, versioning, and observability built
> into the runtime. Written in Rust; single binary, embedded SQLite by default
> (PostgreSQL/MySQL optional).

Key facts: workflows are pipelines of tasks using JSONLogic; everything is
created as a draft, tested via dry-run, then activated (the engine
hot-reloads); active versions are immutable; connectors are named connections
to external systems (HTTP, SQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Kafka)
referenced from tasks by name. The full documentation concatenated into one
file is at https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/llms-full.txt

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/introduction.html): what Orion is, why it exists, and where to start
- [Is Orion Right for You?](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/comparison.html): what Orion replaces, when not to use it
- [Install & Run](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/getting-started/install.html): install matrix for server and CLI, first run, health check
- [Your First Service](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/getting-started/first-service.html): workflow + channel end-to-end, in four API calls
- [Your First Connector](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/getting-started/first-connector.html): PostgreSQL + the portable data dialect
- [Test & Promote a Service](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/getting-started/test-and-promote.html): lint, dry-run with stubs, regression cases, then export/plan/apply to a second instance
- [Run the Examples](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/getting-started/examples.html): six deployable example packages, with the step-by-step walkthrough
- [The Console (Orion UI)](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/getting-started/console.html): no-code UI over the admin API

## Concepts

- [How Orion Works](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/concepts/how-orion-works.html): the three primitives, one request's journey, sync vs async, dev vs prod topology, extension surface
- [Channels](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/concepts/channels.html): service endpoints — protocols, sync/async, ingress guards, in-process composition
- [Workflows](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/concepts/workflows.html): task pipelines, the data context, conditions, how a version is selected
- [Connectors](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/concepts/connectors.html): named external connections, secrets by reference, operation gates, circuit breakers
- [Packages](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/concepts/packages.html): the module boundary — tags, closure, artifacts, receipts, rollback
- [The Entity Lifecycle](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/concepts/lifecycle.html): draft/active/archived, immutability, what reloads the engine, quarantine

## Operations & deployment

- [Production Checklist](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/production-checklist.html): every pre-go-live setting, with the page that owns each
- [Deploy with Docker](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/docker.html): single container, SQLite volumes, the HA compose topology, upgrades
- [Deploy on Kubernetes (Helm)](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/kubernetes.html): chart, values, probes, migration Job, cluster mode
- [Cluster Mode & High Availability](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/cluster.html): requirements, what is shared vs per-node, migrations as a deploy step, sizing
- [Secure an Instance](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/security.html): admin auth, data-plane auth, TLS, trusted proxies, secrets, SSRF, origins
- [Monitoring & Alerts](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/monitoring.html): logging, Prometheus, OTLP, health endpoints, what to alert on
- [Traces & Async Processing](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/traces.html): trace storage modes, the async queue, the DLQ, retention
- [Timeouts, Retries & Circuit Breakers](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/failure-handling.html): the four timeout levels, the HTTP-only retry rule, breakers, graceful shutdown
- [Promote Between Environments](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/promotion.html): the five package verbs, receipts, secrets, mid-apply failure modes, rollback
- [Back Up & Restore](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/backup-restore.html): per-backend backup, the offline restore procedure, package artifacts as estate backup
- [Audit Logs](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/audit-logs.html): filtering, change context, retention, dropped-event alerting
- [Upgrades](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/upgrades.html): the standing upgrade procedure, preflight first, how a renamed key fails by surface
- [Upgrading to 1.0.0](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/upgrading-to-1.0.html): every 0.3.0 → 1.0.0 break, grouped by type, with the preflight scanner that finds them
- [Troubleshooting](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/operate/troubleshooting.html): symptom-indexed fixes — quarantine, degraded health, 429s behind a proxy, open breakers, DLQ, Kafka lag, empty context

## Reference

- [Admin API](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/admin-api.html): workflows, channels, connectors, packages, engine, audit, trace-DLQ, backup endpoints
- [Data API](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/data-api.html): routing, sync/async processing, traces
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/openapi.html): where the generated 3.1 spec lives and how it is gated
- [Channel Configuration](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/channel-config.html): every config_json key — auth, rate limits, dedup, cache, validation, timeouts, origins, tracing
- [Workflow Schema](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/workflows.html): workflow & task JSON schema, the data context, matching, rollout
- [Expression Language (JSONLogic)](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/expressions.html): the operator catalogue and its silent-failure edges
- [Task Functions](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/functions.html): every task function's exact input schema
- [Connector Types](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/connectors.html): per-type field tables, secret references, operation gates, retries, masking, breakers
- [Portable Data Dialect](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/data-dialect.html): backend-neutral query/write envelope across SQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
- [Configuration Reference](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/configuration.html): every setting, default, and ORION_* environment variable
- [Metrics Reference](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/metrics.html): every exported series, its type and labels
- [Errors & Response Envelopes](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/errors.html): the admin and data envelopes, every error code, verbose_errors
- [CLI Reference](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/cli.html): every orion-server and orion-cli subcommand
- [Design Notes](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/design-notes.html): the reasoning behind dedup, cache keys, hot reload, the guard pipeline
- [Support & Compatibility](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/support.html): versioning policy, what 1.0 freezes, MSRV, platform matrix
- [Glossary](https://goplasmatic.github.io/Orion/reference/glossary.html): one-line definitions of the load-bearing vocabulary
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec (raw)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoPlasmatic/Orion/main/docs/openapi.json): machine-readable API description
